title: Контрабандная пицца в палате  (Contraband Pizza in the Ward)

segments.t: Desperate for real food in the hospital, Chef Barinov tips a delivery courier generously for a pizza, only to learn that the nurses confiscated the box at the entrance. When he finally gets his hands on a pizza, his ward mates immediately beg him to share.
А то ты перлог, вот, достала уже.
Alright, let's go through it step by step in English.
'Barinov, did you order a pizza?' In Russian, the idea of 'you' flows naturally into 'ordered' without extra filler words.
'Yes, yes, yes, yes, yes.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'yes' before landing on 'yes'.
'Here is a thousand rubles.' The grammar packs 'grab' and 'thousand' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange. Max answers right away.
'Nothing is too good for you.' In Russian, the idea of 'for' flows naturally into 'feel sorry for' without extra filler words.
'All the best.' Chef Viktor brings out the contrast between 'of all' and 'good' in a few short words.
'Wait, where is the pizza?' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'and' and finishing on 'where'. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'They took it at the entrance.' The meaning hinges on 'like this' working together with 'entrance' in spoken Russian.
'Vitaly Petrovich.' Max anchors the line on 'Vitaly', while 'Petrovich' completes the thought.
А то ты перлог, вот, достала уже.
'That pearl barley of yours has driven me crazy already.' Chef Viktor brings out the contrast between 'and' and 'then' in a few short words. Max answers right away.
'That is my pizza.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'this' before landing on 'pizza'.
'Pals, that is strictly forbidden for you.' Chef Viktor brings out the contrast between 'friends' and 'for you' in a few short words.
'Next you will be asking for chicken with pineapple?' Notice how Russian expresses 'then' and 'pineapple' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'That one is my favorite.' Chef Viktor brings out the contrast between 'this' and 'my' in a few short words. Alright, let's listen to all those lines again from the top.
А то ты перлог, вот, достала уже.
When you watch Scene 3 of Episode 13, listen out for the exchange around contraband pizza in the ward — you will recognize every Russian phrase right away. See you in the next scene.
